skill_name: Compare and contrast the effects of a volcanic eruption and a tornado.
workflow: The effects of a volcanic eruption and a tornado differ in many ways. A volcanic eruption typically involves the direct eruption of ash, lava, and other materials from a volcano onto the surrounding area. The force of the eruption can be devastating, with ash and lava burying and destroying nearby structures, farmland, and ecosystems.
